# beyondcompare-mcp — full reference

> Short version: [llms.txt](llms.txt)

MCP server for file/folder comparison, directory sync, media-library
inventory, and dev-workspace hygiene via the Beyond Compare engine.
FastMCP 3.4 + FastAPI unified gateway. Ports: frontend 10840 (Vite),
backend 10841 (REST + MCP on /mcp).

## MCP tools (18)

Read-only: compare_files, compare_folders, multimedia_drive_scanner,
find_multimedia_duplicates, detect_usb_drives, find_duplicate_code,
compare_workspace_snapshots, bc_status, bc_help.
Mutating: backup_dev_repositories, analyze_dev_workspace,
scan_repo_health (mutating only with fix_issues=True).
Destructive: sync_folders (mirror deletes target-only files),
cleanup_dev_artifacts, selective_restore, bc_shutdown.
Agentic (sampling client required): beyondcompare_agentic_workflow,
beyondcompare_sampling_hint.

Every tool returns a dialogic dict (success + message). Docstrings carry
## Return Format + ## Examples. Annotations use real MCP hint keys;
output_schema={"type": "object"} on dict tools. See docs/TOOLS.md.

Safety discipline: sync_folders and cleanup_dev_artifacts default to
dry_run=True — always preview before executing.

## REST endpoints (backend :10841)

- GET /api/v1/health — liveness + Beyond Compare detection + uptime
- GET /api/v1/diagnostics — backend/system/tools/cua status
- GET /api/capabilities — static tool manifest for dashboards
- GET /api/skills — skill listing (Chat skill-first preprompt)
- GET /api/logs, GET /api/v1/logs — ring-buffer query
  (limit/offset/sort/level/kind/search/after_id) + {entries, total}
- GET /api/logs/export?format=json|csv — download
- DELETE /api/logs — clear ring
- GET /api/fleet/apps — fleet app registry (Apps Hub)
- GET /api/llm/discover — Ollama (:11434) + LM Studio (:1234) probes
- GET /api/llm/providers — {ollama: [{name}], lm_studio: [{name}]}
- GET /api/llm/models?provider= — model list
- POST /api/llm/chat — backend chat proxy (non-streaming)
- POST /api/llm/chat/stream — SSE data: {"c": chunk} + data: [DONE]
- GET /api/llm/onboarding — starter facts + recommended path
- GET /api/v1/llm/settings|models — legacy paths (kept)
- POST /api/shutdown — orderly exit (200, then ~500 ms exit)
- POST /mcp — MCP streamable HTTP (mounted via mcp.http_app(path="/"))

CORS: explicit origins (10840/10841 localhost + Tauri) plus unconditional
tailnet/LAN/localhost regex. Frontend calls same-origin; absolute backend
URL only inside Tauri.

## Configuration (env)

BEYOND_COMPARE_PATH (auto-detect BC5→BC4→BC3→PATH), LOG_LEVEL=INFO,
BC_SCRIPTS_DIR=./bc_scripts, COMMAND_TIMEOUT=30, MCP_PORT=10841,
MCP_PATH=/mcp, OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434,
MCP_BRIDGE_URLS (optional). See docs/CONFIGURATION.md + .env.example.

## Architecture

src/beyondcompare_mcp/server.py — BeyondCompareMCP (tool registration) +
ensure_fleet_stack() building the FastAPI+FastMCP gateway (single
combined lifespan entering mcp_http.lifespan; mount path="/" at /mcp).
Dual transport: stdio (Claude Desktop, default) + HTTP (dashboard).
tools/developer/ — backup/analyzer/health/duplicates.
multimedia_scanner.py — drive inventory + SHA-256 dedup.
agentic.py — SEP-1577 sampling workflow (ctx.sample; deprecated upstream,
works on 3.x). skills.py — skill:// resource. prompts.py — 3 prompts.
log_ring.py — 500-entry ring (stderr-safe).

## Webapp (web_sota/)

React 19 + Vite + Tailwind + Zustand + TanStack Query. Pages: Overview
(hero + KPIs + onboarding cue), Actions, Inbox, Logs, Compare, Sync,
AI Command (Chat, skill-first + streaming + 4 personalities + 100-msg
localStorage), Tools, Skills, Settings (LLM), Help. API via same-origin
API_BASE (Tauri gate for absolute). Apps Hub discovery: GET
/api/fleet/apps with static fallback.

## Launch

.\start.ps1 (fleet engine: clears :10840/:10841, TCP-polls backend,
opens browser). .\start.ps1 -BackendOnly for backend only.
.\start.ps1 -Headless for background. just serve / just test / just ci.

## Tests

pytest tests/ (ignore test_integration.py): 63 collected, 23 passed,
26 skipped (BC-absent/platform-gated). Coverage fail_under=35.
Ruff: E,F,W,I,B,S,UP,RUF,T20 with per-file ignores for cli/tests/scripts.

## Distribution

MCPB manifest mcpb/manifest.json (command python -m beyondcompare_mcp;
${__dirname} vars only). Claude Desktop drag-install supported.
